name: Design Studio
description: An agent-first native workspace for brand directions, artboards, component boards and working component review.

benchState.help: Read the acknowledged graph, runs, recovery status and Studio metadata for the exact native tab/project. Use tabId to avoid focused-window fallback.

benchRetryStorage.help: Confirm saved workspace state before resuming changes.

benchContent.help: Read artefact content with one original image per reply. imageIds lists owned images; omit imageId for the first, or request one listed id.

benchStageInput.help: Store one original reference image and return its compact owned asset receipt before saving inputs.

benchSaveInputs.help: Save an immutable brief revision in this project. Pass revises for the current input and retain operationId across uncertain replies.

benchChooseDirection.help: Remember the selected image for this exact direction board without revising artwork or approving it.

benchOpen.help: Navigate this project window to an exact artifact revision. newTab is compatibility-only; other projects need studioNewWindow.

benchGenerate.help: Generate four directions, then artboard, then component board from approved sources. format=html converts a component board with an explicit ready coding session. A note revises the current artifact; HTML stays HTML. Never approves.

benchCancel.help: Suppress late output for this exact run and request an interrupt in its acknowledged original coding session. Returns separate interrupt and persistence receipts; a request does not confirm the agent stopped. retryInterrupt retries only a failed interrupt request. Completed runs return outputSuppressed:false without writes.

benchImageStatus.help: check the configured Wonop image tier before generation

publishBuild.help: Publish complete working component HTML for the exact handed-off run and unchanged captured sourceHashes. Requires a live renderer and successful read-back; never approves.

benchImportArtifact.help: Import four direction images, one artboard/component image, or component HTML from an approved source. Outputs remain drafts. Exact corrections pass revises=artifactId.

benchDraftRead.help: Read the native tab input recovery binding, or bounded pending readiness.

benchDraftAttach.help: Verify this native tab binding; UUIDs cannot claim another draft.

benchDraftWrite.help: Checkpoint this tab compact input draft with compare-and-set.

benchDraftImage.help: Read one acknowledged original image belonging to this tab.

benchDraftBegin.help: Persist an exact input-save intent before publication.

benchDraftCommit.help: Publish or reconcile this tab exact durable save intent.

benchDraftConflict.help: Preserve this tab local conflict copy without replacing its saved draft.

benchDraftResolve.help: Choose a compared version at the exact reviewed checkpoint.

benchAnnotationHistory.help: Read resolved comments on this exact artefact revision.

benchReplyAnnotation.help: Reply to an exact revision comment. Reuse operationId when retrying the same send.

benchReopenAnnotation.help: Reopen an exact resolved comment while preserving its thread and anchor.

benchOpenCoder.help: Open Codex or Claude in this Bench workspace through Wonop. Requires separate opening approval. Returns window identity only; refresh sessions to check readiness before starting a task.

studioNewWindow.help: Open a new project in a separate native window.

studioPreferences.help: Read or save this project’s reviewer display name and approval navigation preference.

studioDraft.help: Acknowledge an instruction or selection draft; PNG bytes remain native assets.

studioExport.help: Save the current project graph/provenance manifest; saved=false means canceled.

studioCapture.help: Record an actual isolated HTML render against exact source hashes; never generates an image.

studioEvidence.help: Read one owned comparison image and its immutable capture/feedback provenance.

studioFeedback.help: Persist exact comparison evidence and dispatch a native coding revision. Reuse operationId on an uncertain reply; receipt is not completion.

designsRoot.help: Workspace-relative folder for validated working component HTML. Original artwork and checkpoints remain native assets.

imageTier.help: Configured Settings > AI image tier: cheap, medium or expensive.
